title: Cod and new potato bake with parsley crumbs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or an ordinary staple: crème fraîche, Dijon mustard, breadcrumbs and Parmesan.

supermarket.reason: Cod fillets, new potatoes, spinach and crème fraîche are everyday Tesco items, and nothing is a specialist or treat buy.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a grater and a knife, and the technique is simple roasting and baking.

works.reason: Sliced potatoes get 40 minutes in total at 200°C, the cod gets 15 minutes under a crumb topping, and the spinach wilts in the sauce, which gives a sensible dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers slicing the potatoes and onion, grating the cheese, chopping the parsley and zesting the lemon, and the 40-minute cook time matches 25 plus 15 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and parsley, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: New potatoes form the base of the bake alongside spring spinach and parsley, which suits late April.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British home-cook instructions with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, potatoes and spinach in a creamy sauce under a crisp topping make a proper family meal of real food.
